comparison.git_blob_hash_definition: SHA-1 of b"blob " + ASCII decimal byte length + b"\0" + raw archive bytes
comparison.mode_policy: GitHub tar archive normalizes regular-file mode bits to 0664 and executable mode bits to 0775; API 100644/100755 executable distinction is preserved. Mode normalization is recorded and does not affect path/size/Git blob equality.
comparison.scope: All API recursive-tree entries of type blob at the fixed commit; no source code, archive payload, or repository script was executed.
